release.notes:
The Terms of Service and Privacy Policy have a new version, so Ghost shows its notice with both links once more.
The picture of your agents shows a tick on each connected agent's line.
o7 is now Ghost ADE, at onghost.dev.
The message box and dialogs are tidier.
o7 has a new look called Main.
Remote access in Settings reads more simply.
